Positive diagonal concavity does not imply concavity for elementary-symmetric sums

Myeongjin Kang

Abstract

The four-variable polynomial f=1+2sigma_1+sigma_2+2sigma_3+sigma_4 has strictly positive coefficients and a diagonal fourth root concave on the entire positive axis, while f^(1/4) is not concave on the positive orthant. An exact identity and a strictly interior rational midpoint certificate refute Lachaume Conjecture 1. The literal elementary symmetric functions and regularity are proved in Lean. The older real-rootedness-converse failure is explicitly uncredited.
